text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government and businessmen said in meeting that economic indicators had improved as result of crackdown on smuggling, and expressed will to promote investment.
- Human Rights Minister Abderrahman Amalou meets Mark Deneer, heading U.N. mission to Morocco, to examine ways to reinforce cooperation.
- Social dialogue resurfaces after ministerial meeting chaired by Interior Minister Driss Basri on accord signed in August with unions on pay rises.
- Committee in charge of follow-up of accord signed with unions to meet on Tuesday.
